title: CS 111X (Introduction to Programming)
description: A first programming course: variables, control flow, functions, data collections, and simple algorithms, usually in Python or Java.
notes: Choice slot: UVA's CS 1110, 1111, 1112, or 1113 (versions for different backgrounds). Official descriptions are in data/raw/uva/courses/.

title: HSS/UE
description: A humanities or social sciences elective, or an unrestricted elective chosen by the student.
notes: UVA: 15 HSS credits and 12 unrestricted credits in all.

title: Math/Sci Elective
description: An additional mathematics or natural science course chosen from an approved list.

title: APMA Elective
description: An applied mathematics course beyond calculus, such as linear algebra, differential equations, statistics, or numerical methods.
notes: UVA: APMA electives (9 credits including APMA 3100).

title: CS Elective
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student.

title: CS Capstone
description: A capstone research or project course in which the student produces a technical report, taken alongside the engineering senior thesis.
notes: Choice slot: UVA's CS 4971, CS 4980, or CS 4991.
